steps.run:

else

steps.name: Derive release metadata
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
if [[ ! "$TRIGGER_TAG" =~ ^publish/v([0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+)$ ]]; then
  echo "TRIGGER_TAG must be publish/vX.Y.Z, got: $TRIGGER_TAG" >&2
  exit 1
fi
version="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
{
  echo "version=$version"
  echo "final_tag=v$version"
  echo "manifest_path=release-artifacts/release-manifest-$version.json"
  echo "main_vsix=dev-session-canvas-$version.vsix"
  echo "notifier_vsix=extensions/vscode/dev-session-canvas-notifier/dev-session-canvas-notifier-$version.vsix"
} >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Resolve release ref
steps.run: echo "release_ref=$(git rev-parse HEAD)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Install dependencies
steps.run: npm ci

steps.name: Install release verification browser
steps.run: npx --no-install playwright install --with-deps chromium

steps.name: Assemble same-ref native runtime assets
steps.run:
node scripts/build/assemble-execution-distribution-assets.mjs \
  --source "$RUNNER_TEMP/execution-native-archives" \
  --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/execution-native-platform" \
  --input-sha "${{ needs.resolve-runtime-input.outputs.input_ref }}"
echo "DEV_SESSION_CANVAS_EXECUTION_ASSETS_SET=$RUNNER_TEMP/execution-native-platform" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

steps.name: Verify release input
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
if [[ -f scripts/release/release-preflight.mjs ]]; then
  npm run release:verify -- --version "${{ steps.release.outputs.version }}"
else
  echo "Legacy release ref does not contain release:verify; retaining its existing artifact-validation path."
fi

steps.name: Detect existing GitHub Release assets
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
final_tag="${{ steps.release.outputs.final_tag }}"
manifest_name="$(basename "${{ steps.release.outputs.manifest_path }}")"
main_name="$(basename "${{ steps.release.outputs.main_vsix }}")"
notifier_name="$(basename "${{ steps.release.outputs.notifier_vsix }}")"
release_json="$(mktemp)"
assets_file="$(mktemp)"
api_error="$(mktemp)"

if gh api "repos/{owner}/{repo}/releases/tags/$final_tag" > "$release_json" 2> "$api_error"; then
  node -e '
    const fs = require("fs");
    const release = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1], "utf8"));
    for (const asset of release.assets || []) {
      console.log(asset.name);
    }
  ' "$release_json" > "$assets_file"

  missing=()
  for name in "$manifest_name" "$main_name" "$notifier_name"; do
    if ! grep -Fxq "$name" "$assets_file"; then
      missing+=("$name")
    fi
  done

  if (( ${#missing[@]} > 0 )); then
    echo "GitHub Release $final_tag exists but required assets are missing: ${missing[*]}" >&2
    echo "Refusing to repackage or clobber release assets for an existing release. Repair or delete the incomplete release assets manually, then rerun." >&2
    exit 1
  fi

  echo "GitHub Release $final_tag already has the expected VSIX and manifest assets; reusing them for this rerun."
  echo "mode=reuse" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  exit 0
fi

if grep -q 'HTTP 404' "$api_error"; then
  echo "GitHub Release $final_tag was not found; packaging a new VSIX batch."
  echo "mode=package" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  exit 0
fi

cat "$api_error" >&2
echo "Unable to determine whether GitHub Release $final_tag already exists; refusing to package a new batch." >&2
exit 1

steps.name: Download existing GitHub Release assets
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
final_tag="${{ steps.release.outputs.final_tag }}"
manifest_path="${{ steps.release.outputs.manifest_path }}"
main_vsix="${{ steps.release.outputs.main_vsix }}"
notifier_vsix="${{ steps.release.outputs.notifier_vsix }}"
manifest_name="$(basename "$manifest_path")"
main_name="$(basename "$main_vsix")"
notifier_name="$(basename "$notifier_vsix")"
tmpdir="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmpdir"' EXIT

gh release download "$final_tag" \
  --pattern "$manifest_name" \
  --pattern "$main_name" \
  --pattern "$notifier_name" \
  --dir "$tmpdir"

test -s "$tmpdir/$manifest_name"
test -s "$tmpdir/$main_name"
test -s "$tmpdir/$notifier_name"

mkdir -p "$(dirname "$manifest_path")" "$(dirname "$main_vsix")" "$(dirname "$notifier_vsix")"
mv "$tmpdir/$manifest_name" "$manifest_path"
mv "$tmpdir/$main_name" "$main_vsix"
mv "$tmpdir/$notifier_name" "$notifier_vsix"

steps.name: Validate existing GitHub Release assets
steps.run: npm run release:publish-tag -- --trigger-tag "$TRIGGER_TAG" --skip-package --package-only

steps.name: Package release artifacts
steps.run: npm run release:publish-tag -- --trigger-tag "$TRIGGER_TAG" --package-only

steps.name: Create final release tag
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
final_tag="${{ steps.release.outputs.final_tag }}"
release_ref="${{ steps.ref.outputs.release_ref }}"
git fetch origin --tags

local_ref="$(git rev-parse --verify --quiet "$final_tag^{}" 2>/dev/null || true)"
if [[ -n "$local_ref" && "$local_ref" != "$release_ref" ]]; then
  echo "Local final tag $final_tag points to $local_ref, expected $release_ref." >&2
  exit 1
fi

remote_ref="$(git ls-remote --tags origin "refs/tags/$final_tag" | awk '{print $1}')"
if [[ -n "$remote_ref" && "$remote_ref" != "$release_ref" ]]; then
  echo "Remote final tag $final_tag points to $remote_ref, expected $release_ref." >&2
  exit 1
fi

if [[ -z "$local_ref" ]]; then
  git tag "$final_tag" "$release_ref"
fi
if [[ -z "$remote_ref" ]]; then
  git push origin "$final_tag"
fi

steps.name: Record final release tag in manifest
Write GitHub release notes
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
node scripts/release/write-github-release-notes.mjs \
  --version "${{ steps.release.outputs.version }}" \
  --manifest "${{ steps.release.outputs.manifest_path }}" \
  --output release-artifacts/github-release-notes.md

steps.name: Create or update GitHub Release assets
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
final_tag="${{ steps.release.outputs.final_tag }}"
release_ref="${{ steps.ref.outputs.release_ref }}"
notes_file="release-artifacts/github-release-notes.md"

if release_id="$(gh api "repos/{owner}/{repo}/releases/tags/$final_tag" --jq '.id' 2>/dev/null)"; then
  body="$(cat "$notes_file")"
  gh api --method PATCH "repos/{owner}/{repo}/releases/$release_id" \
    -f target_commitish="$release_ref" \
    -f name="$final_tag" \
    -f body="$body" \
    --silent
else
  gh release create "$final_tag" --target "$release_ref" --title "$final_tag" --notes-file "$notes_file"
fi

gh release upload "$final_tag" \
  "${{ steps.release.outputs.manifest_path }}" \
  "${{ steps.release.outputs.main_vsix }}" \
  "${{ steps.release.outputs.notifier_vsix }}" \
  --clobber

steps.name: Update GitHub Release notes for reused assets
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
final_tag="${{ steps.release.outputs.final_tag }}"
notes_file="release-artifacts/github-release-notes.md"
release_id="$(gh api "repos/{owner}/{repo}/releases/tags/$final_tag" --jq '.id')"
body="$(cat "$notes_file")"
gh api --method PATCH "repos/{owner}/{repo}/releases/$release_id" \
  -f name="$final_tag" \
  -f body="$body" \
  --silent

Merge marketplace manifests
Update GitHub Release manifest and notes
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

node scripts/release/write-github-release-notes.mjs \

steps.name: Delete temporary publish tag
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
final_tag="${{ needs.prepare.outputs.final_tag }}"
release_ref="${{ needs.prepare.outputs.release_ref }}"
manifest_path="${{ needs.prepare.outputs.manifest_path }}"
git fetch origin --tags
final_ref="$(git rev-parse "$final_tag^{}")"
trigger_ref="$(git rev-parse "$TRIGGER_TAG^{}")"

if [[ "$final_ref" != "$release_ref" || "$trigger_ref" != "$release_ref" ]]; then
  echo "Ref mismatch; refusing to delete $TRIGGER_TAG." >&2
  echo "release_ref=$release_ref final_ref=$final_ref trigger_ref=$trigger_ref" >&2
  exit 1
fi

git push origin ":refs/tags/$TRIGGER_TAG"
git tag -d "$TRIGGER_TAG" || true

node -e '
  const fs = require("fs");
  const manifestPath = process.argv[1];
  const manifest = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(manifestPath, "utf8"));
  manifest.tags = {
    ...(manifest.tags || {}),
    finalTag: manifest.finalTag,
    finalTagStatus: "pushed",
    triggerTagStatus: "deleted"
  };
  fs.writeFileSync(manifestPath, `${JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2)}\n`);
' "$manifest_path"
node scripts/release/write-github-release-notes.mjs \
  --version "${{ needs.prepare.outputs.version }}" \
  --manifest "$manifest_path" \
  --output release-artifacts/github-release-notes.md
release_id="$(gh api "repos/{owner}/{repo}/releases/tags/$final_tag" --jq ".id")"
body="$(cat release-artifacts/github-release-notes.md)"
gh api --method PATCH "repos/{owner}/{repo}/releases/$release_id" \
  -f name="$final_tag" \
  -f body="$body" \
  --silent
gh release upload "$final_tag" "$manifest_path" --clobber

steps.name: Fail when marketplace publish failed
steps.run:
echo "Open VSX publish or verification failed. GitHub Release assets and notes were uploaded for manual installation, and the temporary publish tag was kept for rerun. Visual Studio Marketplace is deferred and is not part of the current completion gate."
exit 1
